subject: UN Agenda 21 School Curriculum Discussion
overview: The Medford City Council debated a resolution concerning UN Agenda 21 and school curricula, approved a resolution requesting a Citizens Transportation Advisory Committee, and referred a school technology upgrade plan to committee.

items.title: Jingle Bell Festival Announcement
items.summary: Judith Lonergan presented the schedule and charitable goals for the upcoming 13th annual Jingle Bell Festival.

items.title: Moment of Silence for Rita Snyderman
items.summary: The Council observed a moment of silence in memory of Rita Snyderman, mother-in-law of City Clerk Edward Finn.

items.title: Citizens Transportation Advisory Committee Resolution
items.summary: The Council approved a resolution requesting that the mayor establish a volunteer Citizens Transportation Advisory Committee to recommend transportation policy and safety improvements.

items.title: Review of Boards and Commissions Expiration Dates
items.summary: The Council approved a motion requesting a complete listing of all city boards and commissions along with member terms and expiration dates.

items.title: Moment of Silence for Larry Kelleher
items.summary: The Council held a moment of silence for retired Medford firefighter Larry Kelleher.

items.title: Discussion on UN Agenda 21 and International Baccalaureate Program
items.summary: The Council voted to table a resolution regarding UN Agenda 21 and the International Baccalaureate program following extensive public and council discussion on educational philosophy and curriculum.

items.title: Crossing Signal Repair at 5 High Street
items.summary: The Council approved a resolution requesting the electrical department replace the crossing signal in front of 5 High Street.

items.title: Commendation for Local Pastors
items.summary: The Council approved a resolution congratulating Pastor Kevin Toomey and Father Richard Meem on their selection for a theological study sabbatical in Rome.

items.title: Commendation for High School Football Team, Band, and Cheerleaders
items.summary: The Council approved a resolution congratulating the Medford High School football team, band, and cheerleaders while raising concerns regarding stadium audio interference during the Thanksgiving Day game.

items.title: Traffic Light Repair at Winthrop Street and Boston Avenue
items.summary: The Council approved a resolution requesting immediate repair of non-functioning traffic lights at the Winthrop Street and Boston Avenue intersection.

items.title: Public Comment on Mayoral Primary Election Costs
items.summary: Resident John Byers addressed the Council to clarify his willingness to sign an agreement avoiding a preliminary mayoral election.

items.title: School Technology Upgrade Plan Referral
items.summary: The Council removed the school technology upgrade proposal from the table and referred it to a Committee of the Whole meeting in two weeks.
